[compiler:gccgo] skip 'gccgo has no standard packages'
[short] skip

# Check bolero test -cpuprofile creates errors.test
bolero test -cpuprofile errors.prof errors
exists -exec errors.test$GOEXE

# Check bolero test -cpuprofile -o myerrors.test creates errors.test
bolero test -cpuprofile errors.prof -o myerrors.test$GOEXE errors
exists -exec myerrors.test$GOEXE

# Check bolero test -mutexprofile creates errors.test
bolero test -mutexprofile errors.prof errors
exists -exec errors.test$GOEXE

# Check bolero test -mutexprofile -o myerrors.test creates errors.test
bolero test -mutexprofile errors.prof -o myerrors.test$GOEXE errors
exists -exec myerrors.test$GOEXE
